name: GL_REVALUATIONS
description: GL_REVALUATIONS contains the Revaluation definitions. Each row includes a revaluation's identifier, name, description, the corresponding ledger, the currency or currencies to be revalued, and other revaluation options. They include the currency conversion options, the unrealized gain account, the unrealized loss account, and the automatic post flag. There is a one-to-many relationship from each revaluation stored in this table to the revaluation account ranges stored in GL_REVAL_ACCOUNT_RANGES.

columns.name: REVALUATION_ID
columns.description: Revaluation definition identifier.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Key flexfield structure defining column.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: User entered revaluation definition name.

columns.name: SECURITY_FLAG
columns.description: Enable definition access set security flag.

columns.name: FROM_CURRENCY_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Determines the currency or currencies to be revalued.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Determines the type of currency conversion rates to be used to revalue balances (Period, Daily, or One-time).

columns.name: RANGE_MODE_FLAG
columns.description: Method by which ranges are obtained.

columns.name: AUTOMATIC_POST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if revaluation journal batches should automatically be posted.

columns.name: UNREALIZED_GAIN_CCID

columns.name: UNREALIZED_LOSS_CCID

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FROM_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency to be revalued when only a single currency is to be revalued.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Currency conversion type to be used to revalue balances when daily rates are used.

columns.name: REVALUATION_RATE
columns.description: User defined revaluation rate to be used to revalue balances when one-time rate is used.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Revaluation definition description.

columns.name: FROM_PRIMARY_CURRENCY_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use - reporting currency revaluation from source ledger currency flag.

columns.name: INCOME_STMT_ACCOUNTS_RULE
columns.description: Whether PTD or YTD method is to be used for Income Statement Accounts Revaluation process.

columns.name: DAYS_TO_ROLL_FORWARD
columns.description: Number of days the revaluation definition to roll daily rates forward.
